newsHighlights.title: Second heat wave of summer hits South Africa
newsHighlights.summary: A second summer heat wave is sweeping across South Africa, pushing temperatures dangerously high and raising health warnings for the elderly and children.
newsHighlights.translation: 南非迎来夏季第二轮热浪，气温飙升至危险水平，老年人与儿童的健康风险上升。

newsHighlights.title: FAA lifts nationwide ground stop after thousands of flights disrupted
newsHighlights.summary: US aviation authorities lifted a nationwide ground stop after thousands of flights were disrupted, leaving travelers exhausted and airports crowded.
newsHighlights.translation: 美国航空当局在全国停飞令导致数千架次航班中断后解除禁令，旅客疲惫不堪，机场人满为患。

newsHighlights.title: Microsoft apologizes for global outage, rules out cyberattack
newsHighlights.summary: Microsoft apologized for a global service outage that disrupted work and daily life worldwide, saying it was not caused by a cyberattack.
newsHighlights.translation: 微软就一起波及全球、扰乱工作与日常生活的服务中断事件致歉，并排除了网络攻击的可能。

newsHighlights.title: At 95, American still speaks Qinghai dialect 'I miss you all'
newsHighlights.summary: At 95, American David Plymire still speaks with a distinct Qinghai accent and calls Huangyuan county his hometown after spending 17 years there.
newsHighlights.translation: 95岁的美国人戴维·普莱米尔仍操着一口地道的青海话，在青海湟源县度过17年后，他把那里视作故乡。

newsHighlights.title: Max Baucus: China, US should build more trust and maintain balance
newsHighlights.summary: Former US ambassador Max Baucus said China and the US should build more trust and maintain balance, praising China's offer to convene AI cooperation.
newsHighlights.translation: 美国前驻华大使博卡斯表示，中美应增进互信、保持平衡，并赞赏中方提出的人工智能合作倡议。

quote.author: Virgil
quote.explanation: 健康是一切的基础。无论是面对热浪、航班延误还是网络中断，良好的身体状态都是应对生活突发状况的本钱；这与今日新闻中95岁老人健康长寿的故事相呼应。

vocabulary.definition: 热浪；持续的异常高温天气
vocabulary.example: A second heat wave of summer is putting the elderly at risk.
vocabulary.translation: 夏季第二轮热浪正让老年人面临风险。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自CGTN新闻标题：'Second heat wave of summer hits South Africa'。

vocabulary.example: Thousands of flights were disrupted by the nationwide ground stop.
vocabulary.translation: 全国停飞令导致数千架次航班中断。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自CGTN新闻标题：'FAA lifts nationwide ground stop after thousands of flights disrupted'。

vocabulary.definition: （供电、网络或服务的）中断，停止运行
vocabulary.example: Microsoft apologized for a global outage that affected millions of users.
vocabulary.translation: 微软为一次影响数百万用户的全球服务中断事件道歉。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自CGTN新闻：'Microsoft apologizes for global outage, rules out cyberattack'。

vocabulary.example: Passengers should expect more flight cancellations in the coming days.
vocabulary.translation: 乘客应做好未来几天更多航班取消的准备。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自CGTN新闻标题：'Expect more flight cancellations, US transport chief says'。

vocabulary.example: Daily exercise builds resilience against both heat and stress.
vocabulary.translation: 日常锻炼能增强抵御高温与压力的适应力。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联今日热浪与航班中断新闻：极端天气与突发状况考验个人与社会的 resilience（应对与恢复能力）。

vocabulary.example: At 95, David Plymire still speaks the Qinghai dialect fluently.
vocabulary.translation: 95岁的戴维·普莱米尔仍能流利地说青海话。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自ChinaDaily报道：'At 95, American still speaks Qinghai dialect'。

vocabulary.example: He spent 17 years in Huangyuan county and calls it his hometown.
vocabulary.translation: 他在湟源县生活了17年，并把那里称作故乡。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自ChinaDaily报道：'He spent 17 years in Huangyuan county, Qinghai province, and considers it as his hometown.'

vocabulary.example: Travelers should expect more flight disruptions this week.
vocabulary.translation: 旅客应预计本周还会有更多航班中断。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自CGTN新闻标题：'Expect more flight cancellations, US transport chief says'。

vocabulary.example: Microsoft apologized to users affected by the global outage.
vocabulary.translation: 微软向受全球服务中断影响的用户致歉。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自CGTN新闻：'Microsoft apologizes for global outage, rules out cyberattack'。

vocabulary.example: A balanced diet and enough sleep help you maintain good health.
vocabulary.translation: 均衡饮食和充足睡眠有助于保持健康。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自ChinaDaily新闻标题：'Max Baucus: China, US should build more trust and maintain balance'。

pattern.pattern: Expect + 名词短语, ... says.（表示权威预测：预计将会……）
pattern.example: Expect more flight cancellations, US transport chief says.
pattern.translation: 美国交通部门负责人表示，预计还会有更多航班取消。
pattern.usage: 这是新闻英语中的预告句型，用祈使句 Expect... 表达官方或专家的预测，随后用 ..., ... says 标明消息来源。日常中可用于提醒他人做好准备，如：Expect heavy traffic tomorrow, the weather service says（气象部门表示，明天交通会很拥堵）。

grammar.title: after 引导的时间状语从句中的省略（省略 "were"）
grammar.explanation: 在 after, before, when, until 等连词引导的时间状语从句中，若从句主语与主句一致或为被动结构，常可省略 "主语 + be 动词"，仅保留过去分词，使表达更简洁。新闻标题尤其常用这一形式。原完整句为：FAA lifts nationwide ground stop after thousands of flights were disrupted，标题中省略了 were。
examples: FAA lifts nationwide ground stop after thousands of flights disrupted. (完整形式: after thousands of flights were disrupted)
Microsoft apologized for the global outage after (it was) investigated, ruling out a cyberattack.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第二个音节 -rup-。注意 /ʌ/ 是短促的"阿"音，嘴唇放松；词尾 -tion 发 /ʃn/，不是 /tiən/。可拆解为 dis-RUP-shon 三拍，重读音节要读得更响、更长。
examples: The outage caused serious disruption to daily life.
Thousands of flights were disrupted by the ground stop.

reading.title: Staying Healthy When the Weather and the Web Break Down
reading.content: As a second heat wave grips South Africa, health experts remind people to drink more water, stay indoors at midday and check on elderly neighbors. Extreme heat is not just uncomfortable; it can be dangerous for young children and older adults. At the same time, travelers in the United States faced chaos after thousands of flights were disrupted, and a Microsoft outage affected work and daily life around the world. When systems fail, our own health becomes our best safety net. Doctors say the preparation is simple: sleep well, eat balanced meals, drink enough water and move every day. Good habits also help the mind stay calm during delays and uncertainty. At 95, American David Plymire still speaks the Qinghai dialect he learned decades ago. He credits a quiet life, close friends and a strong sense of belonging for his long and healthy life. Health, after all, is the quiet foundation beneath every journey.
reading.translation: 随着第二轮热浪席卷南非，健康专家提醒人们多喝水、中午尽量待在室内，并关照年迈的邻居。极端高温不仅是不舒服，对幼儿和老年人来说还可能很危险。与此同时，美国的旅客因数千架航班中断而陷入混乱，一次微软服务中断也影响了全球的工作与日常生活。当系统失灵时，我们自身的健康就是最好的安全网。医生表示，准备工作其实很简单：睡好觉、饮食均衡、喝足水、每天运动。良好的习惯也能帮助我们在延误和不确定中保持心态平静。95岁的美国人戴维·普莱米尔至今仍会说几十年前学会的青海话。他把自己漫长而健康的人生归功于平静的生活、亲密的朋友和强烈的归属感。毕竟，健康是每一次旅程之下安静的基石。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于CGTN真实新闻《Second heat wave of summer hits South Africa》《FAA lifts nationwide ground stop after thousands of flights disrupted》《Microsoft apologizes for global outage》以及ChinaDaily报道《At 95, American still speaks Qinghai dialect》改写，用于英语学习。
